description: Carmine Tsunami (DEV-0196, QuaDream) is a threat actor linked to an Israel-based private sector offensive actor known as Qua Dream. They are associated with the iOS malware KingsPawn and have targeted civil society actors in various regions. Their operations include mobile device exploitation, domain registrar abuse, and use of cloud hosting infrastructure.
